abstract: The diagnostic value of fine needle biopsy was assayed in the diagnosis of ovarian tumours in women. Our material comprised malignant tumours with different histological structures, benign tumours such as different kinds of cysts, teratomata and myomas. In the investigated cases of ovarian cancer the cytologic examination was in accord with the following histopathologic results. The cytologic findings failed to determine the microscopic pattern of the cancer. Teratomata were diagnosed cytologically in all cases under consideration. In the remaining tumours the results of cytologic evaluation were in accordance with the histologic examinations in the view of dismissing of tumour under study. The method seems to be very helpful in early diagnosis of malignant ovarian tumours as well as in the evaluation of the character of some tumours. The latter might be particularly important in cases presenting counterindication to laparotomy.
abstract_ja: 卵巣腫瘍の診断における細針生検の診断的価値を検討した。対象は、さまざまな組織学的構造を有する悪性腫瘍、各種嚢胞などの良性腫瘍、奇形腫および筋腫であった。卵巣癌症例では細胞診所見は組織学的所見と一致した。細胞診では腫瘍の顕微鏡的パターンを決定できなかった。奇形腫はすべての症例で細胞診により診断された。その他の腫瘍では、細胞診の結果は組織学的検査と一致し、検討対象腫瘍の除外診断となった。本法は悪性卵巣腫瘍の早期診断や一部腫瘍の性状評価に非常に有用と思われる。特に開腹術の禁忌がある症例では重要と考えられる。
